'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Terwilliger LS Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)|OVS15-22-Rebel_Cell_Hidden_Landing_Site-remaster.webp|label=Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
